captions.detailed: A carbon-fibre dropper seatpost consisting of a dark, matte outer tube and a slightly narrower inner post. The inner post moves vertically inside the outer tube via a prismatic joint, representing height adjustment. At the top of the inner post is a low-profile inline saddle clamp assembly with two light grey metallic rails for mounting a bicycle saddle.
captions.instruction: Generate a model of a carbon-fibre dropper seatpost. It should feature a dark-colored outer tube, a telescoping inner post connected via a prismatic joint, and a low-profile inline saddle clamp with light grey mounting rails at the top.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube as a main cylinder with a slightly flared collar at the top. Model the inner post as a smaller concentric cylinder that fits inside the outer tube. Build the saddle clamp at the top of the inner post using a combination of small box primitives for the clamping brackets and horizontal cylinders for the mounting rails. Define a prismatic joint between the outer tube and the inner post to allow vertical height adjustment.
